name: Entertainer
description: Artists, performers, and media personalities who make their living through creative expression.

assignments.name: Artist
assignments.description: You are a writer, sculptor, painter, or other creative artist.

assignments.name: Journalist
assignments.description: You report on local or galactic events for a media corporation.

assignments.name: Performer
assignments.description: You are an actor, dancer, acrobat, professional athlete, or other public performer.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: You are invited to take part in a controversial event or exhibition.
events.effectDescription: Roll Art or Persuade 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: reduce SOC by 1.

effects.detail: Art/Persuade 8+ for Benefit or lose SOC

events.description: You join a group of like-minded travellers on an expedition.
events.effectDescription: Gain any one of Animals (Riding) 1, Survival 1, Stealth 1 or Seafarer 1.

effects.detail: Gain Animals (Riding) 1, Survival 1, Stealth 1 or Seafarer 1

events.description: One of your works is especially well received and earns you money.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

events.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field.
events.effectDescription: Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.

events.description: You go on a tour of the sector, visiting many worlds.
One of your pieces of art is widely illegally copied and you lose income.
You win a prestigious prize for your work.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll and SOC +1.

events.description: You gain a patron in the arts.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll and gain an Ally.

events.description: You win a major award for your work.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: You expose or are involved in a scandal of some sort.
You are betrayed by a peer. One of your Contacts or Allies betrays you, ending your career. That Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy.
mishaps.effectDescription: A Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy.

mishaps.description: An accident, Loss of Confidence or otherwise causes you to lose a term.
mishaps.effectDescription: No additional effect beyond leaving career.

mishaps.description: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
